name: better-tg-cli
stderr:
Usage: tg [options] [command]

Fast Telegram CLI for reading, searching, and sending messages

Options:
  -V, --version                                        output the version number
  -h, --help                                           display help for command

Commands:
  auth [options]                                       Log in with your own api_id/api_hash, or with an invite (--invite)
  onboard [options]                                    Guided login for agents: opens a local page where you get an invite (or use your own keys), scan a QR code and enter your 2FA password; the agent never sees any of it
  logout                                               Clear saved session (log out)
  check                                                Verify session and credentials
  whoami [options]                                     Show logged-in account information
  chats [options]                                      List chats (IDs first; use the ID in other commands)
  read [options] <chat>                                Read messages from a chat (newest first; --asc for chronological)
  get [options] <chat> <ids...>                        Fetch specific messages by ID
  info [options] <chat>                                Show details of a chat, group, channel, user or bot (members, about, linked chat, forum)
  topics [options] <chat>                              List forum topics of a forum supergroup (use the ID with read/send --topic)
  link [options] <chat> <messageId>                    Get the t.me link to a message in a channel or supergroup
  contacts [options]                                   List your contacts
  search [options] <query>                             Search messages in one chat (--chat) or across all chats (default)
  inbox [options]                                      Show unread messages summary (most unread first)
  buttons [options] <chat> <messageId>                 List the buttons attached to a bot message
  pinned [options] <chat>                              List pinned messages in a chat
  reactions [options] <chat> <messageId>               List who reacted to a message and with what
  stories [options] <user>                             List a user's currently active stories
  avatar [options] <chat>                              Download a user's or chat's profile photo
  inline [options] <bot> <query>                       Query an inline bot (like typing "@bot query" in Telegram)
  watch [options] [chat]                               Stream new incoming messages in real time (until timeout / limit / Ctrl-C)
  contact [options] <user>                             Get contact information
  members [options] <group>                            List group members
  admins [options] <group>                             List group admins
  groups [options]                                     List groups
  kick [options] <group> <user>                        Kick/remove a user from a group
  promote [options] <group> <user>                     Promote a group member to admin
  transfer-owner [options] <group> <user>              Transfer group/channel ownership to another member (irreversible)
  mute [options] <chat>                                Mute a chat
  unmute [options] <chat>                              Unmute a chat
  folders [options]                                    List all folders with their chats
  folder [options] <name>                              Show chats in a specific folder
  folder-add [options] <folder> <chat>                 Add a chat to a folder
  folder-remove [options] <folder> <chat>              Remove a chat from a folder
  send [options] <target> <message>                    Send a message
  reply [options] <chat> <msg-id> <message>            Reply to a message
  send-file [options] <target> <path>                  Send a photo or document to a chat
  click [options] <chat> <messageId> [button]          Press a button on a bot message (inline callback, reply keyboard, etc.)
  react [options] <chat> <messageId> [emoji]           React to a message
